newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Chinese firm in Sri Lanka cement joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Chinese firm in Sri Lanka cement joint venture.

text.p: China's Yantai Fushan Foreign Trade Corporation plans to set up a local joint venture to manufacture cement in Sri Lanka, the state-run Daily News said on Friday.
The newspaper said the Chinese firm will tie-up with Sri Lanka's Industrial Development Board and Impala Industrial Corportion to set up the plant in western Puttalam district.
The proposed $12 million plant, with an annual capacity of 300,000 tonnes, will meet 10 percent of Sri Lanka' annual cement demand, the newspaper quoted officials as saying.
The Indian Ocean island currently imports about one million tonnes of cement every year, it said.
The newspaper did not give further details.
